welcome_page.hero_badge: Digital at the Service of the Community
welcome_page.hero_title: Your Community Supported Agriculture, finally simple
welcome_page.hero_subtitle: Break free from Excel, WhatsApp, and confusion. doliGAS is the ethical platform that saves Coordinators time and brings Producers closer
welcome_page.how_it_works_title: From the soil to your table, with simplicity
welcome_page.how_it_works_subtitle: We have translated years of farming experience into a clear path that respects everyone's work.
welcome_page.step1_desc: Farmers update real availability, sharing what the land offers right now.
welcome_page.step2_desc: The community market opens. Choose the products you prefer, with the calm of knowing what you are buying.
welcome_page.step3_desc: We make logistics more efficient and distribution faster. Fewer manual calculations and fewer errors, leaving more time for community life.
welcome_page.step4_desc: Pick up your box at the delivery point: a concrete gesture of support for your local economy.
welcome_page.community_title: A tool at the service of everyone
welcome_page.ecosystem_title: Much more than just management software
welcome_page.ecosystem_subtitle: An integrated system where every module talks to the others. Distribution, production, and certification cooperate in real-time in a single shared digital flow.
welcome_page.mod_doligas_desc: Intuitive dashboard to manage orders, deliveries, and payments without stress.
welcome_page.mod_dolitrace_desc: Quality certification and traceability: field log, crop operations, harvests, and management costs.
welcome_page.mod_dolifarm_desc: The heart of the ecosystem for complete business management. ERP/CRM, master data, and resources.
welcome_page.mod_agropass_desc: An act of responsibility. Digital passport and agroecological index for every farm.
welcome_page.showcase_subtitle: Interfaces designed for people, not for databases
welcome_page.role_producer_desc: We guarantee the right dignity for your work, simplifying sales so you can get back to the field sooner.
welcome_page.role_coordinator_desc: We are your right hand. Fewer Excel sheets, less stress, more time to grow the group.
welcome_page.role_member_desc: Total transparency on every product and the convenience of an order that benefits the territory.
welcome_page.view_admin_desc: Everything under control in a single view: orders, cash, and deliveries. Without the headache of manual accounts.
welcome_page.view_shop_desc: A peaceful and clear experience. Order from producers in your area without the confusion of emails, messages, or long waits.
welcome_page.cta_dolifarm_title: Evolve your community, we are looking for the first 10 Pioneer Groups
welcome_page.cta_dolifarm_desc: Join the first 10 groups: have your say on the software roadmap and receive dedicated VIP support to migrate your historical archives without stress. Only 10 spots available for the launch phase.
welcome_page.integration_subtitle: doliGAS speaks the language of those who produce. It is directly connected to doliFARM, the tool farmers use to take care of their business.
welcome_page.feat_erp_desc: The farmer manages daily work on doliFARM. doliGAS shows only what is truly ready to be harvested.
welcome_page.feat_trace_desc: It's not just a cart: every purchase carries the story of the batch, the field, and the producer.
welcome_page.feat_sync_desc: No double effort. If the harvest in the field changes, the community price list updates automatically.
welcome_page.eco_footer: The development of doliGAS generated only 1.5 kg of CO2e: the impact of a 10 km car journey, invested to eliminate thousands of km of logistical waste. However, we do not use any external services, and we do not give any data to third parties.
welcome_page.ethics_subtitle: The software you choose is a political act
welcome_page.feat_opensource_desc: Based on Dolibarr, the code is open source. Data belongs to the Group and is exportable in open format (GDXP) at any time. github.org/dolifarm
welcome_page.feat_privacy_desc: The member archive, order history, and all other data are the Group's heritage, hosted on European servers regulated by GDPR.
welcome_page.feat_ownership_desc: We do not earn commissions on consumption or production. doliGAS is developed with minimal impact to eliminate thousands of km of real logistical waste.
welcome_page.footer_opensource: Open Source Software for an independent supply chain
welcome_page.sustainability_text: doliGAS is open software, you do not pay usage licenses. We only ask for a sustainable contribution for the services that simplify your life: secure hosting, backups, updates, and dedicated support. Want to install it yourself? You can do it for free. Want us to take care of it? We are here for that.
welcome_page.form_message_placeholder: Briefly tell us what you need...
welcome_page.form_privacy_checkbox: I accept the processing of my personal data to be contacted.
welcome_page.form_success: Request received! We will reply very soon.
